name: GitLab CI/CD Free
free_limit: 400 compute minutes/month per GitLab.com Free top-level namespace on eligible GitLab-hosted instance runners
watch_out: Minutes are calculated as job duration multiplied by the runner/project cost factor and shared across the namespace. When the monthly quota is exhausted, additional hosted-runner jobs can be blocked; purchased extra compute and storage are separate. Self-managed runners use your own infrastructure.
